title: Line sketch: Luminous Liquid Vortex

Edge-traced line art of: The artwork depicts swirling, viscous liquid forms in vibrant and tones, with glossy highlights and scattered droplets against a gradient background. Smooth digital rendering emphasizes the glossy, translucent quality of the forms (derived from painting #29).
